creator: Infinite Arena Studio
inputDescription: A ring of runes on the ground that eats enchantment and spirit-work inside it
environmentalInteractions: Turns the warded circle into dead ground for enchanters and spirit-workers — fights inside it are settled by muscle, steel, and aim.
Layered over a choke point it forces arcane kits to route around or fight hollow.
sideEffects: Suppresses BOTH teams' magic and spirit expression inside the ring — your own mystics go quiet too.
It is a field, not an object: it cannot be destroyed, only waited out or walked out of.
counterplay: Step outside the 10 m ring — the runes do not follow.
Wait out its 70-second duration; the circle burns itself out.
Draft fighters whose kits carry neither magic nor spirit tags and claim the warded ground for free.
visualManifestation: A ring of ash-white runes seared into the ground, a faint grey shimmer standing knee-high above them; spell-light entering the ring simply goes out.
audioManifestation: A low choral drone that swallows the usual chime of spellwork into silence.
provenance: Curated Season 0 template: anti-arcane suppression field archetype.
